# S77 — A queued run whose project was removed does not start

S05 (landed 67521b0) admits a queued run in startQueuedLocked (internal/daemon/runs.go:352-387) using hasRoomLocked (:326-350). When the run's project is no longer in the registry, hasRoomLocked finds no project (find, handlers.go:135) and applies no project cap, so the run starts. Noted in the S05 run report.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

A run of a project that is no longer registered starts with no per-project cap and with a runDeps and project that the registry no longer describes.

## Files

- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: startQueuedLocked and hasRoomLocked.
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`: a test beside the S05 wave tests.
- Related: S38 (projects rm refuses while the project has unfinished runs) removes the usual way to reach this state. Check its state before running this slice.

## Failing tests

- TestQueuedRunOfARemovedProjectStopsWithAReason: a queued run whose project is no longer in the registry when its turn comes is stopped with the reason "project was removed" and never started.
- The S05 tests still pass (TestQueuedRunStartsWhenASlotFrees).

## Implement

In startQueuedLocked, look the project up in the registry (or the cached registry from S76 if it has landed) when a queued run is next in line. If the project is gone, stop the run with the reason "project was removed" instead of starting it, and go on to the next queued run. Write the failing test first. Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): keep this slice; stop with the reason. Nothing is open.
